description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ThingPreconditionNotModifiedException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for scenarios involving HTTP 304 Not Modified responses due to precondition validation failures related to 'if-none-match' headers on a 'Thing' resource. It includes exception metadata, builder pattern, and JSON deserialization logic.

classes.name: ThingPreconditionNotModifiedException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception representing a 'Precondition Not Modified' error in the context of Eclipse Ditto, indicating that a conditional request's precondition failed, leading to an HTTP 304 response.
